name: Okernel_fix
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  build:

    name: Build Kernel for Xiaomi Mi10 UMI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout Source
      uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1

    - name: Cleanup Disk Space
      run: |
        sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet
        sudo rm -rf /opt/ghc
        sudo rm -rf "/usr/local/share/boost"
        sudo rm -rf "$AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY"

    - name: Install Dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y build-essential git curl wget bison flex zip bc cpio libssl-dev ccache python-is-python3

    - name: Setup Cache (ccache)
      uses: actions/cache@v5
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/ccache_mikernel
        key: kernel-ccache-umi-build-miui.sh-${{ github.run_id }}
        restore-keys: |
          kernel-ccache-umi-build-miui.sh-
          kernel-ccache-umi-
          kernel-ccache-

    - name: Setup Toolchain (Neutron Clang 18)
      run: |
         mkdir -p $HOME/neutron-clang
         cd $HOME/neutron-clang
         wget -q https://github.com/Neutron-Toolchains/clang-build-catalogue/releases/download/05012024/neutron-clang-05012024.tar.zst
         tar --zstd -xvf neutron-clang-05012024.tar.zst

    - name: Integrate SUSFS Kernel Patch
      run: |
         echo "========== Applying SUSFS kernel-side patch (kernel 4.19) =========="
         # This is the piece the previous workflow was missing: ReSukiSU only provides
         # the KernelSU-side glue code for SUSFS, it does NOT patch the core kernel
         # (fs/, include/linux/) with susfs_def.h, susfs.c, or the hooks in files like
         # fs/proc/task_mmu.c. Without this, drivers/kernelsu/Kbuild aborts the build
         # with "You have not integrated susfs in your kernel yet."
         SUSFS_PATCH_URL="https://github.com/JackA1ltman/NonGKI_Kernel_Build_2nd/raw/refs/heads/mainline/Patches/Patch/susfs_patch_to_4.19.patch"

         echo "-- Downloading SUSFS kernel patch for 4.19..."
         curl -LSs --fail --retry 3 -o /tmp/susfs_patch_to_4.19.patch "$SUSFS_PATCH_URL" || {
           echo "Fatal: failed to download susfs_patch_to_4.19.patch!"
           exit 1
         }

         echo "-- Applying SUSFS kernel patch..."
         set +e
         patch -p1 --fuzz=5 --forward < /tmp/susfs_patch_to_4.19.patch
         PATCH_RC=$?
         set -e

         REJ_FILES=$(find . -name "*.rej")
         if [ -n "$REJ_FILES" ]; then
           echo "-- The following hunks did not apply cleanly:"
           for f in $REJ_FILES; do
             echo "  ===== $f ====="
             cat "$f"
             echo "  ============================================="
           done
         fi

         echo "-- Verifying core susfs headers/sources landed in the tree..."
         MISSING=0
         for f in include/linux/susfs.h include/linux/susfs_def.h fs/susfs.c; do
           if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then
             echo "Fatal: expected file '$f' is missing after patching."
             MISSING=1
           fi
         done
         if [ "$MISSING" -eq 1 ]; then
           exit 1
         fi

         # Known issue: fs/proc/task_mmu.c hunk #8 can fail on kernels whose task_mmu.c
         # has drifted from the patch's expected base (this device's walk_page_range()
         # uses a newer 5-arg signature than the patch assumes). Rather than leaving
         # the CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MAP feature silently missing, actively repair it.
         if [ -n "$REJ_FILES" ]; then
           ONLY_TASK_MMU=$(echo "$REJ_FILES" | grep -v "fs/proc/task_mmu.c.rej" || true)
           if [ -n "$ONLY_TASK_MMU" ]; then
             echo "Fatal: unexpected reject(s) outside fs/proc/task_mmu.c.rej - resolve before continuing."
             exit 1
           fi
         fi

         echo "-- Checking fs/proc/task_mmu.c for known SUSFS patch gaps..."

         # Gap 1: missing susfs_def.h include (needed for CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_KSTAT)
         if ! grep -q "susfs_def.h" fs/proc/task_mmu.c; then
           if grep -q '^#include <linux/pkeys.h>$' fs/proc/task_mmu.c; then
             printf '%s\n' \
               'path = "fs/proc/task_mmu.c"' \
               'with open(path) as f:' \
               '    content = f.read()' \
               '' \
               'anchor = "#include <linux/pkeys.h>\n"' \
               'insert = "#ifdef CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_KSTAT\n#include <linux/susfs_def.h>\n#endif\n"' \
               '' \
               'if anchor not in content:' \
               '    print("FATAL: anchor include not found.")' \
               '    raise SystemExit(1)' \
               '' \
               'content = content.replace(anchor, anchor + insert, 1)' \
               'with open(path, "w") as f:' \
               '    f.write(content)' \
               'print("   -> inserted susfs_def.h include after pkeys.h include.")' \
               > /tmp/fix_task_mmu_include.py
             if ! python3 /tmp/fix_task_mmu_include.py; then
               echo "   -> Fatal: could not insert susfs_def.h include."
               exit 1
             fi
           else
             echo "   -> Fatal: anchor '#include <linux/pkeys.h>' not found; cannot insert susfs_def.h."
             exit 1
           fi
         else
           echo "   -> susfs_def.h include already present."
         fi

         # Gap 2: missing SUS_MAP bypass inside pagemap_read()
         if ! grep -q "SUSFS_IS_INODE_SUS_MAP" fs/proc/task_mmu.c; then
           if grep -q 'ret = walk_page_range(mm, start_vaddr, end, &pagemap_ops, &pm);' fs/proc/task_mmu.c; then
             printf '%s\n' \
               'path = "fs/proc/task_mmu.c"' \
               'with open(path) as f:' \
               '    content = f.read()' \
               '' \
               'old = ("\t\tret = down_read_killable(&mm->mmap_sem);\n"' \
               '       "\t\tif (ret)\n"' \
               '       "\t\t\tgoto out_free;\n"' \
               '       "\t\tret = walk_page_range(mm, start_vaddr, end, &pagemap_ops, &pm);\n"' \
               '       "\t\tup_read(&mm->mmap_sem);\n"' \
               '       "\t\tstart_vaddr = end;")' \
               '' \
               'new = ("\t\tret = down_read_killable(&mm->mmap_sem);\n"' \
               '       "\t\tif (ret)\n"' \
               '       "\t\t\tgoto out_free;\n"' \
               '       "#ifdef CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MAP\n"' \
               '       "\t\t{\n"' \
               '       "\t\t\tstruct vm_area_struct *vma = find_vma(mm, start_vaddr);\n\n"' \
               '       "\t\t\tif (vma && vma->vm_file && SUSFS_IS_INODE_SUS_MAP(file_inode(vma->vm_file)))\n"' \
               '       "\t\t\t\tgoto bypass_orig_flow;\n"' \
               '       "\t\t}\n"' \
               '       "#endif\n"' \
               '       "\t\tret = walk_page_range(mm, start_vaddr, end, &pagemap_ops, &pm);\n"' \
               '       "#ifdef CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MAP\n"' \
               '       "bypass_orig_flow:\n"' \
               '       "#endif\n"' \
               '       "\t\tup_read(&mm->mmap_sem);\n"' \
               '       "\t\tstart_vaddr = end;")' \
               '' \
               'if old not in content:' \
               '    print("FATAL: anchor block for pagemap_read walk_page_range() not found verbatim.")' \
               '    raise SystemExit(1)' \
               '' \
               'content = content.replace(old, new, 1)' \
               'with open(path, "w") as f:' \
               '    f.write(content)' \
               'print("   -> inserted CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MAP bypass into pagemap_read().")' \
               > /tmp/fix_task_mmu_sus_map.py
             if ! python3 /tmp/fix_task_mmu_sus_map.py; then
               echo "   -> Fatal: could not locate exact walk_page_range() block to patch for SUS_MAP."
               exit 1
             fi
           else
             echo "   -> Fatal: anchor 'walk_page_range(mm, start_vaddr, end, &pagemap_ops, &pm);' not found."
             exit 1
           fi
         else
           echo "   -> SUSFS_IS_INODE_SUS_MAP bypass already present."
         fi

         rm -f fs/proc/task_mmu.c.rej fs/proc/task_mmu.c.orig

         echo "-- SUSFS kernel patch integrated and fs/proc/task_mmu.c gaps auto-resolved."

    - name: Cloning the necessary resources
      run: |
          echo "========== Integrating ReSukiSU =========="
          KSU_SETUP_URI="https://github.com/ReSukiSU/ReSukiSU/raw/refs/heads/main/kernel/setup.sh"
          KSU_SETUP_BRANCH="main"
          echo "-- Running ReSukiSU setup..."
          curl -LSs --fail --retry 3 "$KSU_SETUP_URI" | bash -s "$KSU_SETUP_BRANCH" || {
          echo "ReSukiSU setup failed!"
          exit 1
          }

          echo "-- Applying SuSFS inline hook patches..."
          curl -LSs --fail --retry 3 "https://github.com/JackA1ltman/NonGKI_Kernel_Build_2nd/raw/refs/heads/mainline/Patches/susfs_inline_hook_patches.sh" | bash || {
          echo "Inline hook patch failed!"
          exit 1
          }

          echo "-- DEBUG: locating init_rc_hook symbol --"
          grep -rln "ksu_is_init_rc_hook_enabled\|ksu_init_rc_hook" . --include=*.h --include=*.c || echo "not found anywhere"

          echo "Clone AnyKernel3 for packing kernel (repo: https://github.com/AstideLabs/AnyKernel3)"
          git clone https://github.com/socialdoctor555-droid/AnyKernel3 -b Skernel --single-branch --depth=1 anykernel
          echo ".......Anykernel sources cloned....."

          echo "Downloading Droidspaces non-GKI kernel patches......."
          mkdir -p /tmp/droidspaces-patches
          curl -fsSL -o /tmp/droidspaces-patches/02.fix_restore_cgroup_file_prefix_handling.patch \
          "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ravindu644/Droidspaces-OSS/main/Documentation/resources/kernel-patches/non-GKI/02.fix_restore%20cgroup%20file%20prefix%20handling%20.patch"

          echo "Building for MIUI Display configuration....."
          dts_source=arch/arm64/boot/dts/vendor/qcom
          cp -a ${dts_source} .dts.bak

    - name: Nomount Integration
      run: |
         DEFCONFIG="vendor/umi_defconfig"
         MAIN_DEFCONFIG="arch/arm64/configs/${DEFCONFIG}"
         KERNEL_VERSION=$(grep -m1 '^VERSION = ' Makefile | awk '{print $3}').$(grep -m1 '^PATCHLEVEL = ' Makefile | awk '{print $3}')

         # Default exports
         export NOMOUNT_PATCH="https://github.com/maxsteeel/nomount/raw/refs/heads/master/kernel/patches/nomount_${KERNEL_VERSION}_kernel_integration.patch"
         export NOMOUNT_CODE="https://github.com/maxsteeel/nomount/raw/refs/heads/master/kernel/src/nomount.c"
         export NOMOUNT_HEADER="https://github.com/maxsteeel/nomount/raw/refs/heads/master/kernel/src/nomount.h"

         echo "-- Setting up nomount for kernel version [$KERNEL_VERSION] --"
         echo "-- Target defconfig: [$MAIN_DEFCONFIG] --"

         # Download nomount patch, code, and header
         wget -qO- "$NOMOUNT_PATCH" | patch -s -p1 --fuzz=5 || { echo "-- Fatal: Failed to apply nomount patch!"; exit 1; }
         wget -qO- "$NOMOUNT_CODE" > "${PWD}/fs/nomount.c" || { echo "-- Fatal: Failed to download nomount.c!"; exit 1; }
         wget -qO- "$NOMOUNT_HEADER" > "${PWD}/fs/nomount.h" || { echo "-- Fatal: Failed to download nomount.h!"; exit 1; }

         # Enable the necessary Nomount configs
         echo "CONFIG_NOMOUNT=y" >> "$MAIN_DEFCONFIG"
         echo "-- nomount config appended to $MAIN_DEFCONFIG --"

    - name: Rekernel Integration
      run: |
         DEFCONFIG="vendor/umi_defconfig"
         MAIN_DEFCONFIG="arch/arm64/configs/${DEFCONFIG}"

         # Default exports
         export REKERNEL_PATCH="https://github.com/JackA1ltman/NonGKI_Kernel_Build_2nd/raw/refs/heads/mainline/Patches/Rekernel/rekernel_patches.sh"
         export REKERNEL_EXTRA="https://github.com/JackA1ltman/NonGKI_Kernel_Build_2nd/raw/refs/heads/mainline/Patches/Rekernel/rekernel_extra.patch"

         echo "-- Setting up rekernel..."
         echo "-- Target defconfig: [$MAIN_DEFCONFIG] --"

         # Download rekernel patch and extra patch
         wget -qO- "$REKERNEL_PATCH" | bash || { echo "-- Fatal: Failed to apply rekernel patch!"; exit 1; }
         wget -qO- "$REKERNEL_EXTRA" | patch -s -p1 --fuzz=5 || { echo "-- Fatal: Failed to apply rekernel extra patch!"; exit 1; }

         # Enable the necessary Rekernel configs
         echo "CONFIG_REKERNEL=y" >> "$MAIN_DEFCONFIG"
         echo "-- rekernel config appended to $MAIN_DEFCONFIG --"

    - name: Baseband Guard Integration
      run: |
         DEFCONFIG="vendor/umi_defconfig"
         MAIN_DEFCONFIG="arch/arm64/configs/${DEFCONFIG}"

         # Default exports
         export BBG_SETUP_URI="https://github.com/vc-teahouse/Baseband-guard/raw/main/setup.sh"

         echo "-- Setting up Baseband Guard..."
         echo "-- Target defconfig: [$MAIN_DEFCONFIG] --"

         # Start of baseband guard integration
         curl -LSs --fail --retry 3 "$BBG_SETUP_URI" | bash &> /dev/null || { echo "Fatal: BBG setup failed!"; exit 1; }
         echo "CONFIG_BBG=y" >> "$MAIN_DEFCONFIG"

         # Check and configure LSM Hooks
         if grep -q "#define DEFINE_LSM(lsm)" "include/linux/lsm_hooks.h" 2>/dev/null; then
             if grep -q "^CONFIG_LSM=" "$MAIN_DEFCONFIG"; then
                 sed -i 's/^\(CONFIG_LSM=".*\)"/\1,baseband_guard"/' "$MAIN_DEFCONFIG"
                 echo "-- Appended baseband_guard to existing CONFIG_LSM."
             else
                 echo 'CONFIG_LSM="lockdown,yama,loadpin,safesetid,integrity,selinux,smack,tomoyo,apparmor,bpf,baseband_guard"' >> "$MAIN_DEFCONFIG"
                 echo "-- Added default CONFIG_LSM with baseband_guard."
             fi
         else
             echo "-- NOTE: DEFINE_LSM macro not found in include/linux/lsm_hooks.h, skipping CONFIG_LSM wiring (this kernel may register LSMs differently)."
         fi

         # Check and remove duplicate task_security_struct
         if grep -q "struct[[:space:]]\+task_security_struct[[:space:]]\+\*selinux_cred" "security/selinux/include/objsec.h" 2>/dev/null; then
             echo "-- Removing duplicate task_security_struct definition..."
             sed -i '/static inline struct task_security_struct \*selinux_cred/,/[[:space:]]*}/d' security/baseband-guard/tracing/tracing.c
         fi

         echo "-- Baseband Guard integrated."
         echo "-- DEBUG: CONFIG_LSM line in source defconfig after edit:"
         grep -n "CONFIG_LSM=" "$MAIN_DEFCONFIG" || echo "  (no CONFIG_LSM= line present in $MAIN_DEFCONFIG at all)"
         echo "-- DEBUG: CONFIG_BBG line in source defconfig after edit:"
         grep -n "CONFIG_BBG=" "$MAIN_DEFCONFIG" || echo "  (no CONFIG_BBG= line present)"

    - name: SUSFS Integration
      run: |
         DEFCONFIG="vendor/umi_defconfig"
         MAIN_DEFCONFIG="arch/arm64/configs/${DEFCONFIG}"

         echo "-- Kernel source was already patched with susfs_patch_to_4.19.patch in the"
         echo "   'Integrate SUSFS Kernel Patch' step. This step only wires up the Kconfig --"
         echo "-- Target defconfig: [$MAIN_DEFCONFIG] --"

         echo "-- Locating KernelSU driver directory --"
         if [ -d "KernelSU" ]; then
           KSU_DIR="KernelSU"
         else
           echo "-- Fatal: Could not locate the KernelSU driver directory (expected ./KernelSU)."
           exit 1
         fi

         echo "-- Available SUSFS Kconfig options in this ReSukiSU build: --"
         grep -rho "config KSU_SUSFS[A-Z_]*" "$KSU_DIR" 2>/dev/null | sort -u || echo "(none found - check KSU_DIR path)"

         echo "..............Applying SUSFS kernel configs......."
         {
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_PATH=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MOUNT=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_AUTO_ADD_SUS_KSU_DEFAULT_MOUNT=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_AUTO_ADD_SUS_BIND_MOUNT=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_KSTAT=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_TRY_UMOUNT=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_AUTO_ADD_TRY_UMOUNT_FOR_BIND_MOUNT=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SPOOF_UNAME=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_ENABLE_LOG=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_HIDE_KSU_SUSFS_SYMBOLS=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SPOOF_CMDLINE_OR_BOOTCONFIG=y"
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_OPEN_REDIRECT=y"
           # Manual (non-kprobe) hook is already integrated -> sus_su MUST stay disabled
           echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_SU=n"
         } >> "$MAIN_DEFCONFIG"

         echo "-- susfs config appended to $MAIN_DEFCONFIG --"
         echo "-- NOTE: unknown/unsupported CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_* keys are silently ignored by the kernel build,"
         echo "   they will just not appear in the generated .config. Compare the grep output above against"
         echo "   the list appended here if a feature doesn't show up after 'make olddefconfig'."

    - name: Config Preparation
      run: |
         # NOTE: these defaults must match the ones in build-miui.sh.
         export PATH="$HOME/neutron-clang/bin:/usr/lib/ccache:$PATH"
         export CCACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/ccache_mikernel"
         export CC="clang"
         export CXX="clang++"
         export CCACHE_COMPILERCHECK=content
         export CCACHE_SLOPPINESS=time_macros,include_file_mtime,include_file_ctime

         DEFCONFIG="vendor/umi_defconfig"

         MAKE_ARGS="ARCH=arm64 \
           SUBARCH=arm64 \
           O=out \
           CC=clang \
           HOSTCC=clang \
           CLANG_TRIPLE=aarch64-linux-gnu- \
           CROSS_COMPILE=aarch64-linux-gnu- \
           CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32=arm-linux-gnueabi- \
           CROSS_COMPILE_COMPAT=arm-linux-gnueabi- \
           LD=ld.lld \
           AR=llvm-ar \
           NM=llvm-nm \
           OBJCOPY=llvm-objcopy \
           OBJDUMP=llvm-objdump \
           STRIP=llvm-strip"

         echo "CCACHE_DIR: [$CCACHE_DIR]"
         echo "DEFCONFIG: [$DEFCONFIG]"

         echo "......Generating base defconfig......."
         make $MAKE_ARGS "$DEFCONFIG"

         echo "-- DEBUG: CONFIG_LSM in out/.config right after '$DEFCONFIG' merge:"
         grep -n "CONFIG_LSM=" out/.config || echo "  (CONFIG_LSM not present in out/.config after initial defconfig merge - problem is in the merge step itself, or the value was never in the source defconfig)"
         echo "-- DEBUG: CONFIG_BBG in out/.config right after '$DEFCONFIG' merge:"
         grep -n "CONFIG_BBG" out/.config || echo "  (CONFIG_BBG not present - this Kconfig symbol may not exist under this exact name; check security/baseband-guard/Kconfig)"

         echo "-- Exporting required SELinux symbols..."
         unstatic() {
         local file="$1"
         local regex="$2"

         if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
         echo "  -> WARNING: file not found, skipping: $file"
         elif grep -q "static $regex" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
         sed -i "s/static $regex/$regex/" "$file"
         echo "  -> Exported: $regex"
         else
         echo "  -> WARNING: pattern not found in $file, symbol stays static: $regex"
         fi
         }
         unstatic "security/selinux/selinuxfs.c" "const struct file_operations sel_handle_status_ops"
         unstatic "security/selinux/selinuxfs.c" "DEFINE_MUTEX(sel_mutex);"
         unstatic "security/selinux/ss/services.c" "struct page \*selinux_status_page;"
         unstatic "security/selinux/ss/services.c" "DEFINE_MUTEX(selinux_status_lock);"
         unstatic "security/selinux/ss/services.c" "DEFINE_RWLOCK(policy_rwlock);"
         unstatic "security/selinux/hooks.c" "struct security_operations selinux_ops"

         echo "-- Locating write_op declaration for selinux_hide export..."
         WRITE_OP_FILE=$(grep -rl "write_op\[\]" security/selinux/ 2>/dev/null | head -n1)
         if [ -z "$WRITE_OP_FILE" ]; then
           echo "  -> WARNING: could not locate 'write_op[]' anywhere under security/selinux/"
           echo "  -> Searching whole tree as fallback..."
           WRITE_OP_FILE=$(grep -rl "write_op\[\]" --include=*.c . 2>/dev/null | head -n1)
         fi
         if [ -z "$WRITE_OP_FILE" ]; then
           echo "  -> WARNING: 'write_op[]' not found anywhere in the tree. Cannot export it."
         else
           echo "  -> Found in: $WRITE_OP_FILE"
           echo "  -> Before:"
           grep -n "write_op\[\]" "$WRITE_OP_FILE"
           if grep -qE "^static.*write_op\[\]" "$WRITE_OP_FILE"; then
             sed -i '/write_op\[\]/ s/^static //' "$WRITE_OP_FILE"
             echo "  -> Exported: write_op[] in $WRITE_OP_FILE"
           else
             echo "  -> WARNING: line containing 'write_op[]' does not start with 'static' - inspect manually, forcing removal of any leading 'static' token on that line as a best effort."
             sed -i '/write_op\[\]/ s/\bstatic[[:space:]]\+//' "$WRITE_OP_FILE"
           fi
           echo "  -> After:"
           grep -n "write_op\[\]" "$WRITE_OP_FILE"
         fi

         echo "..............Applying Droidspaces required kernel configs......."
         ./scripts/config --file out/.config \
         --enable CONFIG_NAMESPACES \
         --enable CONFIG_PID_NS \
         --enable CONFIG_UTS_NS \
         --enable CONFIG_SYSVIPC \
         --enable CONFIG_IPC_NS \
         --enable CONFIG_DEVTMPFS

         echo "........Resukisu Integration..........."
         ./scripts/config --file out/.config \
         --enable CONFIG_KSU \
         --enable CONFIG_KSU_MULTI_MANAGER_SUPPORT \
         --enable CONFIG_KPM \
         --enable CONFIG_HAVE_SYSCALL_TRACEPOINTS \
         --enable CONFIG_THREAD_INFO_IN_TASK

         echo "Resolving config dependencies......."
         make $MAKE_ARGS olddefconfig

         echo "-- DEBUG: CONFIG_LSM in out/.config after olddefconfig:"
         grep -n "CONFIG_LSM=" out/.config || echo "  (CONFIG_LSM was WIPED by olddefconfig - Kconfig dependency for this symbol isn't satisfied, or the LSM list references a module not enabled in this config)"
         echo "-- DEBUG: CONFIG_BBG in out/.config after olddefconfig:"
         grep -n "CONFIG_BBG" out/.config || echo "  (CONFIG_BBG absent after olddefconfig)"

    - name: Applying Droidspaces Patches
      run: |
         echo "Applying Droidspaces non-GKI kernel patches......."
         for patch_file in /tmp/droidspaces-patches/*.patch; do
         echo "  -> Applying: $(basename "$patch_file")"
         if ! patch -p1 -N --forward < "$patch_file"; then
         echo "     Note: patch may already be applied or failed to apply cleanly - check manually if the build breaks."
         fi
         done

    - name: Build Kernel
      run: |
        chmod +x build-miui.sh
        echo "Using build-miui.sh....."
        bash build-miui.sh

    - name: Upload Artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
      with:
        name: O-kernel
        path: ./*.zip
        if-no-files-found: error

    - name: Upload Patch Rejects (debug)
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
      with:
        name: susfs-patch-rejects
        path: "**/*.rej"
        if-no-files-found: ignore
